revision: S6 schematic, 6HP placement (two columns, side power header): Bread Modular 8bit for Eurorack, 6HP
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Single hole pair at X12.58 (Doepfer X7.5 moved 1HP right), as modules/12bit, hats and 16bit. The repository skiff rails are 10 mm wide centred on Y3.0/Y125.5, leaving the clear Y8.0..120.5 (112.5 mm) gap; the PCB keeps 1.25 mm margin at each end.

main_pcb.note: 29.0 x 110.0 mm (as modules/12bit), 2 layers, 1.25 mm inside the skiff rail gap at each end; held by the four jack bushings/nuts. The pots have no bushing or nut (user stock): soldered only. All assembled SMD on B. 1 mm copper-edge keep-out (min_copper_edge_clearance 1.0).

panel_order: User, 2026-11-14: MIDI + CV on one line at the top; three knobs spread over the middle, zigzag left / right / left; MODE (record) button + its LED on one row above the outputs; OUT (DAC) + GATE as low as the 1 mm keep-out allows; power header upright at the right edge.
row_note: Two columns X7.95 / X22.05 (as modules/12bit: the RV09 courtyards keep 1.02 mm to the board edges). Rows on a 20 mm pitch, the jack-to-knob spacing of modules/mcc: jacks Y17.5, P1 Y37.5 (left), P2 Y57.5 (right), P3 Y77.5 (left), MODE + LED Y97.5; OUT / GATE Y110.4 (courtyard 1.02 mm above the bottom edge). Neighbouring knobs are 24.5 mm apart centre to centre.
jack_rotation_note: Rotation 0: T pad 4.92 mm above the bushing centre, TN 3.38 mm and S 6.48 mm below it.

pots.role: P3 (50k, PB5; S6: was the passive low-pass)

pot_note: Bread Modular RV09 footprint (pins 7.5 mm below the shaft on 2.5 mm pitch, bracket tabs 9.6 mm apart on the shaft line). User stock pots, as modules/audio-out: no threaded bushing, no nut, 16 mm knurled shaft above the body; 3D proxy hardware/8BIT.3dshapes/RV09_proxy.step (from audio-out). pot_shaft_offset_mm = shaft centre relative to the footprint origin at rotation 0. Rotation 0: pins below the shaft, pin 1 on the left (front view), so CW turns the wiper toward pin 3.

button.part: Generic 6 x 6 mm THT tact switch, 4 pins, 7 mm tall (body 3.1 mm, tapered round stem 3.9 mm, Ø3.4 to Ø3.2), pins 6.5 x 4.5 mm, 0.7 mm legs; pins 1-2 and 3-4 are joined inside (along the 6.5 mm side)
button.note: THT on the carrier F side (faces the panel), hand-soldered; the legs come through to B. Stock KiCad SW_PUSH_6mm_H7.3mm. Placed by the pad-pattern centre = stem centre, rotation 0: pad 1 pair (BUTTON) on the top row Y95.25, pad 2 pair (GND) Y99.75; legs X4.70 / X11.20. The panel rear is 3.0 mm above the stem top; a one-piece printed cap (panels/button-actuator) bridges it.

leds.note: 3 mm red THT on F, pads along Y centred on XY; right of the MODE button, above the GATE jack.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.led_note: 3 mm LED body (flange to dome) is 5.3 mm; body bottom at Z6.3 puts the dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front (Z11.6) and 0.4 mm recessed in the 2.0 mm print. The stock KiCad LED_D3.0mm model already stands its flange at Z3.0, so the board model offset is +3.3 mm.
stack_Z_mm.source: Slices of the Bread Modular AudioJacks STEP models (PJ301M-12.step, PJ366ST.step); the library marks them 'Untested', so measure real jacks before committing the LED stand-off.
stack_Z_mm.pot_note: User RV09 (as modules/audio-out): body 6.8 mm nominal, 1 mm collar, shaft to Z22.8 (11.2 mm past the FR4 front). No bushing, no nut. Measure a real pot before ordering panels.
stack_Z_mm.switch_note: Measured SW1: 7.0 mm tall, body 3.1 mm, tapered stem 3.9 mm (Ø3.4 at the body to Ø3.2 at the top). switch_stem_D is the mean stem diameter in the socket grip zone (Z4.5..7.0: Ø3.33..3.2).

power_header.orientation: Upright at the right board edge (user, 2026-11-14: power connector at the side), rot 180 on B, as modules/12bit: odd pins on the inner column X23.8, even pins on X26.34; pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom Y90.5, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top Y80.34. Courtyard X22.01..28.13 (1.37 mm from the right edge).
power_header.idc_note: A 16-pin cable plugs on aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V, at the bottom); positions 11-16 overhang upward over the board, never past an edge. Envelope = 2x8 socket (25.4 x 6.4 mm body, 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres) plus a 1.2 mm key bump on either side. No THT lead under it: the RV2 pins end at Y65.9 (3.0 mm above), the LED pads start at Y95.33 (1.0 mm below). B-side SMD under it must stay <= 2 mm tall.

back_side_tht.note: Eurorack power, right edge, upright, rot 180 on B: pins 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom
UPDI (pin 1 UPDI at the top, pin 2 GND), right edge between the CV jack and P2, hand-soldered on B

smd_parking.note: tools/build_layout.py parks every SMD part here, off the right board edge, in reference order. They move onto the board group by group with the manual routing (root AGENTS.md); the routed native PCB then owns placement and copper (docs/mechanics.md lists the groups).

cap.note: one piece, printed socket-down; press-fits over the switch stem, its flange is held behind the panel, its tip passes the panel hole

button_actuator.travel_note: Switch travel ~0.25 mm. Flange 1.4 mm above the switch body, 1.5 mm below the panel rear (the 0.3 mm of rev 1 let the panel press the flange and hold the switch on); tip 1.9 mm (FR4 front Z11.6) / 1.5 mm (print front Z12.0) proud of the panel.

lfo_panel.note: LFO variant of the 6HP panel (firmware/lfo, no MIDI) for the same S6 carrier: every hole of the main panel except the J1 MIDI jack and the RV3 (P3) shaft. J1 and RV3 are not fitted: the LFO firmware reads neither, and S6 needs no wire bridge (RV3 is only an ADC knob now). GATE stays: the LFO drives PA7 as a square at the LFO rate. P1/P2 stay where the carrier pots are.

lfo_4hp_panel.note: LFO panel for the old 4HP S5/R4 carrier (the board before the 6HP S6, git ec1ebe8^; its own 4HP panels were replaced by the 6HP set). User direction 2026-11-23: same as the old 4HP LFO panel (firmware/lfo) but with the J1 MIDI jack hole, so a board with J1 fitted takes this panel; it replaces the old 4HP LFO panel (no MIDI hole, git ec1ebe8^ panels/front-pcb/8bit-lfo-panel.kicad_pcb). Hole positions are the old 4HP contract (control column X10.0, git ec1ebe8^ docs/geometry.json); RV3 (P3, the 4HP passive low-pass knob) stays omitted with LFO at its spot: without RV3 a wire from RV3 pin 3 to the wiper pad (pin 2) keeps the DAC path (as the knob fully CW, docs/mechanics.md). firmware/lfo reads no MIDI; the hole only fits the jack.
